topic.title: Team up — open to merging (ranks ~6-60, different pipelines)
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hi all, yves mouaha here. I'm open to a team merge before the Dec 7 deadline.

What I bring:

  • A reproducible 0.455 base and 35+ scored submissions (COCONUT/PubChem popularity priors, ICEBERG and GLACIER rescoring, MetFrag-lite, tautomer handling), including what did NOT help, so we don't waste submissions.
  • A validation bench on enveda-180 (same instrument as the test) in progress, to tune without overfitting the 31% public split.
  • Daily availability for experiments and submission management.

What I'm looking for: a team whose pipeline differs from the public 0.455 lineage, so that a rank-level fusion adds real diversity.

Prize split: Kaggle default (even shares). No code or data shared before a merge, per the rules. Comment below or send a team invite to "yves mouaha".
